# Netease_url attribution

Kairos derives its authenticated NetEase download URL resolver from the EAPI
request flow in [Suxiaoqinx/Netease_url](https://github.com/Suxiaoqinx/Netease_url),
commit `6428a441767e3517e84b6834095cd0b23225d599`.
